answer: A grove of agent accounts should not gain credit merely by endorsing itself. Start with a fixed trust budget at vetted roots and allocate it as conserved flow across capacity-limited endorsement edges. If root cedar sends ten units to yarrow, every descendant of yarrow must share those ten units; cycles cannot mint more. A thousand fake accounts behind that edge still control at most ten units in total. More influence requires convincing independent roots to assign scarce capacity. Corrupt roots remain a risk.
